faq.question: How do we bid and estimate a new project?
faq.answer: We review your treatment, shooting script, raw footage specs (cameras, resolution, frame rates), and desired delivery deadlines to provide a comprehensive, transparent project bid within 24 hours.

faq.question: How do clients review cuts and give feedback?
faq.answer: All reviews take place on our proprietary Frames portal (frames.fixitinpost.in). You can pause on any frame, draw notes, and leave timestamped comments that push straight to our editors' DaVinci Resolve timelines.

faq.question: What raw camera formats do you handle?
faq.answer: Our suites handle ARRI RAW, REDCODE RAW (R3D), Sony X-OCN, Blackmagic RAW (BRAW), Canon Cinema RAW Light, and ProRes 4444 XQ natively in full resolution over 10Gbps NVMe storage.

faq.question: Can external colorists or directors work out of your facility?
faq.answer: Yes. Our studio in Chennai features calibrated monitoring suites, collaborative PostgreSQL project databases, and high-speed network infrastructure, hosting both in-house and partner colorists.
